rows.answer: On it. Your name is Priya. I looked into the best umbrellas for windy cities. Priya, for a windy Seattle weekend, get the Repel Windproof Travel Umbrella if you want the best value, or the Blunt Metro if wind resistance matters most. Pair either with a hooded waterproof jacket, because Seattle gusts can still make any umbrella awkward near the waterfront.
